company.name: PartnerStack
company.shortDescription: PartnerStack enables companies to accelerate growth with partnerships
company.description:
PartnerStack (YC15) is the leading partnership ecosystem platform built for B2B SaaS companies that want to drive predictable revenue growth through partnerships.

Our platform helps businesses scale by attracting, engaging, and managing partnerships—from affiliates to strategic alliances—with unprecedented ease and efficiency. Today, PartnerStack powers partner ecosystems for some of the world’s fastest-growing tech companies, enabling them to unlock new revenue streams, expand market reach, and maximize customer lifetime value.

Recognized as a category leader, PartnerStack has fundamentally reshaped how companies approach partnerships, turning what used to be a tactical channel into a strategic growth engine.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $28,853,010, or 79.76% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,544,079 to $121,716,213, a 78.83x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 70 (-15 over 90 days) and market heat at 61 (-14).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include impact.com, Partnerize, TUNE.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
